name: QryG Search
description:
A keyboard-driven launcher inspired by macOS Spotlight: Top Hit, inline completion, a preview pane, filters, and plugins for files, a calculator, units, currency, colours, time, emoji, windows, processes, shell commands and the web. Open it with Super+Space, and type a prefix like "gen " to see how a plugin works.

Clipboard: answers like calculator results are copied to the clipboard when you press Enter or a copy button. The Clipboard plugin reads your history from the Copyous extension, if it is installed, and never sends it anywhere.

Network: the Currency plugin downloads daily exchange rates from open.er-api.com. Nothing else is sent unless you open a web search or install a plugin from a link.

Plugins run code on your computer. Only add plugins you trust.
